Our Approach

BRING BACK THE COLOR.

Good teak furniture is built to last decades, but the finish does not. A season or two outside and it turns gray, dry and rough.

We clean each piece, let it dry, then oil it by hand until the grain is rich again. Cushions come off before we start and go back on when the wood is ready.

✦Every surface done, including legs, slats and undersides you can see
✦Oil wiped back so it dries clean, not tacky
✦Patio and pavers protected from drips
✦Cushions and furniture reset when finished
